subject: Annual prepaid credits: invoicing schedule & VAT proofs
messages:
From: Claire Nguyen <claire.nguyen@acme.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com
Cc: acctpay@acme.com
Date: 2026-06-21T08:15:00-04:00
Subject: Annual prepay — invoicing cadence + VAT proof request

Hi Jonas,

We're finalizing the purchase order for our annual committed spend (USD 240,000) and need to lock the invoicing cadence and VAT/tax paperwork so our AP team can schedule payments. Two quick asks: 

1) Do you have a recommended invoice schedule? Acme prefers quarterly invoices where possible but we can do an annual invoice if Redwood needs that for accounting.
2) Please send Redwood's tax documents we need for our records: W-9 (or local equivalent) and any EU VAT registration proof for services provided outside the US.

Also attaching the PO draft (PO-4567) — please confirm the invoice remit details and whether you can include a running prepaid balance ledger in each invoice (so our systems can automatically match).

Thanks — Claire
Claire Nguyen
Senior Procurement Manager, Acme Corp
Attachments: 2026-06-21_ACME_PO_4567.pdf
From: jonas_weber@redwood.com
To: Claire Nguyen <claire.nguyen@acme.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2026-06-21T11:04:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Annual prepay — invoicing cadence + VAT proof request

Hi Claire — thanks for the PO and the clear asks. Happy to confirm proposed approach below and flag anything you want changed.

Summary proposal (recommended):
- Billing cadence: Default = annual prepaid invoice (single invoice for USD 240,000) with monthly drawdown ledger emailed to finance. Optional = quarterly invoicing (4 x 60k) if Acme requires.
- Invoice contents: invoice PDF + CSV ledger that shows opening prepaid balance, monthly usage, drawdown amount, and closing balance. We can include invoice-level reference: Deal ACME-2026-001 and PO-4567.
- Tax docs: attaching Redwood W-9 and our UK VAT registration cert.
- Payment terms: Net 30 from invoice date (can be shortened to Net 15 for the quarter if you prefer).

Action items for us: rishi, can you confirm we can generate the monthly CSV ledger in the format Acme needs (invoice_id, period_start, period_end, tokens_billed, tokens_remaining, amount_drawn, balance_remaining)?

Claire — if you prefer quarterly invoicing for AP matching, we can do that; otherwise the single annual invoice plus monthly ledger is our operationally simplest path and minimizes bank transfer fees.

— Jonas
Jonas Weber
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com, Claire Nguyen <claire.nguyen@acme.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2026-06-22T09:32:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Annual prepay — invoicing cadence + VAT proof request

Hi all,

Confirmed — we can produce the monthly CSV ledger in the requested columns. Attached is a sample amortization workbook showing how the monthly draws will be computed from the prepaid amount (see tab "monthly_ledger_example"). We will include invoice_id and PO reference on every CSV.

Notes and options:
- If Acme chooses quarterly invoices, we'll generate 4 invoice PDFs and 4 corresponding ledgers; the amortization will allocate spend evenly unless you provide a usage forecast and want a custom allocation.
- For VAT: Redwood will issue invoices from Redwood US (W-9 provided) by default. For EU VAT handling, if services are consumed in Acme's EU entity we can issue an invoice with VAT details referencing our UK VAT number (attached). If Acme requires reverse-charge treatment, please confirm your EU VAT ID and whether you want us to suppress VAT on the invoice.

Marissa — can you confirm our standard remit details (bank wire and ACH) and whether we need a separate SPA or contract signature before sending the annual invoice?

Thanks,
Rishi
Head of Revenue Ops, Redwood Inference
